problem:
The row echelon form matrix $B$ is given below. What are its **non**-pivot columns?

$$
B=[\begin{aligned}-6 & 2 & 1 & 0 & 4 \\ 0 & 0 & -4 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 & 3\end{aligned}]
$$
worked_solution:
Remember that the pivots of a matrix in row echelon form are the first non-zero entries in each row of the matrix.

We can see that $B$ has $3$ pivots in the $1$st, $3$rd and $5$th columns:

$$
B=[\begin{aligned}-6 & 2 & 1 & 0 & 4 \\ 0 & 0 & -4 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 & 3\end{aligned}]
$$

Therefore, the only non-pivot columns are the $2$nd and $4$th columns.
